name: shohei
description: Rust infrastructure diagnostics MCP server for AI agents. Automate DNS checks, TLS certificate chain inspection, email security validation, global DNS propagation checks, and DNS latency benchmarking.

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Query DNS records for a domain.

tools.name: check_tls_chain
tools.description: Inspect a hostname's live TLS certificate chain and optionally check DANE/TLSA records.

tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Check MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records for a domain.

tools.name: check_propagation_global
tools.description: Check DNS propagation consistency across global resolvers.

tools.name: benchmark_latency
tools.description: Benchmark DNS lookup latency across supported transports.
